Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, Bernard Bresnahan writes:
> The superior version of Propaganda forces the person being bled to tap
> an untapped minion. What is the timing on this? (Ack! never thought
> I'd ask a timing question).

It occurs when the bleed resolves (remains unblocked).

> Assume I'm bleeding my prey who has one untapped minion
>
> I call an attempt to Bleed with Propaganda at superior
>
> Does my prey tap the minion prior to declaring a block of the action?
> -Or-
> Does my prey only tap a minion if the action is successful?

The latter. And, to be clear, she'll tap a minion even if the bleed amount
ends up reduced to zero or less (an unsuccessful bleed, but still a
successful action).
